description.value: The Juan de Fuca Branch is part of the Greater Victoria Public Library system, serving the western communities of the Capital Regional District along the Island Highway corridor. As a public library it offers a welcoming, climate-controlled indoor space with public computers and digital collections. It is operated by the Greater Victoria Public Library, which maintains a network of branches across the greater Victoria area.
